policy: All 122 original DRK printings are rendered. 121 frozen, independently normalized scan poses; Ball Lightning remains unscored. Gaea’s Touch 77† has a previously identified shifted ink layer and does not train or validate shared symbol geometry. Thirty-two calibration and eighty-eight repeatedly inspected validation printings retain their original membership. Material-balanced geometry uses signed local contrast and filled area. No per-card renderer settings or scan poses enter the renderer. Native edge, fill and contrast checks are independent of the search proxy. This is regional development evidence, not whole-card certification.

ink.policy: Nineteen eroded interior pixels per card, fixed from the shared geometry before color measurement. Compare the source’s former RGB zero with native shared ink in the same registered interior; this isolates ink tone rather than conflating placement and color. Euclidean encoded-RGB distance is descriptive, not a perceptual color score. Same original train/validation membership; no per-card or per-material target.

reviewQueue: Water Wurm retains a symbol-region regression: its printed crescent appears farther left/larger than the set fit. Retain it in the validation denominator; no per-card adjustment was introduced.
Gaea’s Touch 77† stays outside shared geometry fitting because its ink layer is shifted relative to its aligned frame. Keep the distinct ordinary 77 printing separate.
Ball Lightning retains its previous frame-pose rejection and is rendered but not scored.
Black symbol stroke-width error remains slightly worse than the former oversized rim, despite large edge/fill/contrast gains. Black frame texture also remains a separate color review item.
Type/body layout, measured gold mana transfer and complete-set certification remain open.
